# Important Update: Business Registry Onboarding

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**lance.hall** (5/15/2025):

Good morning, 

**BC Corporations will soon be managed on our new Business Registry platform.**
Based on feedback from initial testing, BC Corporations will now move to the new Business Registry in phases. This iterative approach will allow for continuous system improvement and integration of valuable user feedback. To accommodate this shift, the previously published date of June 2nd is being pushed out.

Stay tuned for more updates.

Thank you.
